title: Liquids in hand luggage
text: Liquids in cabin bags must be in containers of 100 ml or less, packed in one clear resealable bag. Medicines and baby milk are allowed in larger amounts; show them at the security tray.

title: Duty-free collection
text: Duty-free orders placed online are collected at the shop named in the order confirmation. Bring the boarding pass. Some shops can deliver a paid order to the gate if the order is ready at least 30 minutes before departure.

title: Gate opening times
text: Gates open about 45 minutes before departure and boarding closes 15 minutes before departure. Gate numbers can change, so check the screens or this assistant for the live gate.

title: Lost or delayed baggage
text: If a checked bag does not arrive or seems missing, report it before leaving the arrivals hall. Baggage services open a case number and send updates. Most delayed bags are found within one day.

title: Step-free access and assistance
text: Step-free routes use the lifts next to each security checkpoint and the pier train. Assistance can be booked up to 48 hours ahead or requested at the help desk in the check-in hall.

title: Wi-Fi
text: Free Wi-Fi is available across the terminal. Join the HarrowgateGuest network and accept the terms; sessions last four hours and can be renewed.

title: Security wait times
text: Security north usually has longer queues in the morning; security south is often quicker. Live wait times are shown on the departures screens and in this assistant.

title: Missed flight and rebooking
text: If you miss a flight, the airline decides on rebooking and any fare difference. This assistant can look for later flights to the same destination and send a rebooking request for approval.

title: Prayer and quiet rooms
text: A multi-faith prayer room and a quiet room are on the mezzanine above the central plaza, open at all hours.

title: Lounge access
text: The Harrowgate lounge is next to pier B. Entry is by eligible ticket, membership or a day pass bought at the door when space allows.

title: Travelling with children
text: Families with young children may use the family lane at security south. Pushchairs can usually be taken to the aircraft door.

title: Pier train
text: The pier train runs every three minutes between the central plaza and pier C. The ride takes about five minutes.

title: Bag drop closing time
text: Bag drop closes 45 minutes before departure. A bag must reach the right make-up area 25 minutes before departure to travel on the same flight.

title: Lost property in the terminal
text: Items left in the terminal go to lost property in the check-in hall. Describe the item, where and when it was lost, and leave a contact address.

title: Electric scooters and power banks
text: Power banks must travel in cabin bags, never in checked bags. Personal e-scooters are not allowed in the terminal unless they are mobility aids.

title: Food and drink airside
text: Cafes and restaurants are in the central plaza and at the start of each pier. Water refill points are next to every toilet block.
